div.head: IV As 2
div.ab: Et hoc inprimis est, ut obseruentur omnia iudicia, que apud Grateleiam posita fuerunt, preter mercatum ciuitatis et diei dominice.

[De judiciis observandis quæ apud Greateleiam edita fuerent.] [Q/Br] Et hoc inprimis est, ut observentur omnia iudicia, quæ apud Greateleiam posita fuerunt, præter mercatum civitatis et diei Dominicæ.
And first of all; all the decrees shall be observed, which were agreed at Grately, except those which relate to trading in a town and trading on Sunday.

note.label: abrogates
note.quote: the clause ('24:1') banning Sunday trading, its absence logically connected with the deliberations at Thunderfield ('IV') that abrogated previous decisions about Sunday business

note.label: revises (lifts ban)
note.quote: Within a few more years, however, the king seems to have changed his mind. The ban on Sunday commerce was apparently lifted.

div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares II As 24.1; 12.
